name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, and Pi. 42 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: A set of ready-made diagram styles for your AI coding assistant, so it draws clean, professional-looking architecture charts, flowcharts and timelines instead of generic boxes.
buyer: A content creator, technical blogger, or consultant who regularly needs polished diagrams for posts, decks or client reports but doesn't want to pay a designer or fight with Figma each time.
business_use_cases: A technical blogger generates editorial-quality architecture and flow diagrams for every post, matching their site's visual brand automatically.
A consultant creates client-ready process diagrams and org charts for proposals and reports in minutes instead of commissioning design work.
A startup founder turns a scribbled whiteboard flow into a polished diagram for an investor deck without hiring a designer.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'diagram pack' service for content creators and consultants: supply the content, get back a branded set of diagrams for a flat fee.
Build a subscription add-on with custom brand presets and a wider diagram-type library, licensed per team.

steal_this: This weekend, offer three local consultants or bloggers a 'five diagrams for your next report, same day' package using this skill.
